name: mentra-channel
description: Sutando as a MentraOS glasses app (full-duplex channel): wake-phrase-gated live transcription becomes broker tasks (source=mentra via /v1/ingest). Reply delivery has ONE owner via MENTRA_DELIVERY: 'room' (default — broker's INTEGRATION_FALLBACK_ROOM_MENTRA owns all replies, glasses show an ack) or 'glasses' (app server polls /v1/result and renders; requires the broker fallback room env UNSET or replies duplicate). Config-only manifest — run scripts/server.ts (@mentra/sdk AppServer) on the public host; design in DESIGN.md.
